This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their long arms and small [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least two member of this species could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="MJ1" />

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ1" />
